fields.Name: T107 - Dashboard Search
fields.Description: Verifies that the search box in Data Explorer Dashboards filters the dashboard list by name, narrowing to matches or showing a clean no-results state without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Use the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) to open the Data Explorer app, then go to its Dashboards section (route /app/data-explorer/Dashboards). Find the in-section search box for dashboards and type a search term to filter dashboards by name. The success state is that the dashboard list/card view filters to matching dashboards, OR shows a clean 'no results' state if nothing matches. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait for the filtered results to settle, do not navigate away early.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Data Explorer Dashboards section is open and a search term has been entered into its search box
The dashboard list/card view responded to the search - it shows only matching dashboards, or a clean no-results state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
